ASE A6 Electrical Electronics Practice Test
27. Technician A says the resistance of the negative temperature coefficient sensor in the heated seat above decreases as the temperature of the seat increases. Technician B says the two heating elements run in series with each other. Who is correct?
- A. Technician A
- B. Technician B
- C. Both A and B
- D. Neither A or B
